vo: Leftover ham? Dinner is done in twenty minutes, in one pot.
Tortellini Alfredo with ham and peas.
You need cheese tortellini, about a cup and a half of diced ham, frozen peas, heavy cream, Parmesan, butter and garlic.
Boil the tortellini, add the peas for the last minute, then drain.
In the same pot, melt the butter and cook the ham and garlic for three minutes.
Pour in the cream, simmer three minutes, stir in the Parmesan, and fold the tortellini and peas back in.
